name: paper_pseudo_ocv_charge
description: Stage 0 (LFP cells only): pseudo-OCV C/20 charge, opposite direction to 01_pseudo_ocv_discharge.json
comment: LFP only: select the LFP cell at launch. Charge at C/20 from the fully discharged, >=1h-rested state to the selected cell's max_v, with a 0.02C taper cutoff. Average this trace with 01_pseudo_ocv_discharge.json to reduce voltage hysteresis. The EBC necessarily finishes with a CV/taper segment; trim that tail during OCV processing if required.
